title: CTAS: Cross-Trait Aggregation Score for cardiovascular disease — code, derived results and Explorer
description: Code, derived gene- and locus-level results, figure source data and the static interactive Explorer for the Cross-Trait Aggregation Score (CTAS), a dependence-aware gene-level test applied to 16 Pan-UK Biobank cardiovascular traits. Trait dependence is estimated as a transformed rank-correlation matrix, each gene's 16-trait profile is decorrelated by ZCA-cor whitening, and CTAS (magnitude x log2(1 + participation ratio)) is calibrated against 10^9 null draws with genome-wide Benjamini-Hochberg control: 223/99/38 genes and 91/46/21 loci at q<0.05/0.01/0.001. Raw GWAS summary statistics and individual-level data are not included. We want to acknowledge the participants and investigators of the FinnGen study.
